1: * Customer Return Requests - Turn on Return Requests to let signed-in customers request eligible item quantities from completed orders, follow their history and see your decision there. Verified guest access is a separate setup that needs HTTPS. Approval records your decision; it does not refund money, restock products or process a payment.
2: * Checkout Blocks - Collect supported checkout file uploads and show your Place order button text in the WooCommerce Checkout block, alongside existing supported custom fields. Existing module and edition limits still apply; this does not make every Booster option or third-party checkout compatible.
3: * Order and payment reliability - Use WooCommerce order data in affected HPOS exports and reports. Keep Booster gateway fees in sync when an eligible unpaid order changes payment method, without replacing unrelated custom fees.
4: * Understand gateway fees - See why a configured fee applies to a sample guest purchase, and check a summary of your latest up to 50 return requests. These read-only views do not change a shopper cart or predict the final checkout total. Booster Elite adds role and product facts, fee comparisons and payment/shipping rule scenarios.
5: * Hosting requirements - Requires PHP 7.3 or later on a 64-bit build with native integer hrtime() enabled. Use a maintained PHP release supported by your WordPress and WooCommerce versions.
7: * Store updates, without dashboard clutter - Receive short Booster news only on Booster settings pages. Each user can permanently dismiss a notice; store and checkout settings are unchanged.
10: * Wishlist control - Choose to keep saved products after adding them to the cart. Removal remains enabled by default, including after upgrade; disable "Remove from wishlist after adding to cart" to preserve items. Explicit removal still works.
11: * Shipping setup - Clearer guidance shows how separate category and minimum-order free-shipping methods can offer either route without duplicate free options. Existing shipping rules are not changed automatically.
12: * Security - Strengthened handling of customer-supplied product details and document processing to help keep stores protected. Updating is recommended.
13: * Branded document setup - Enter plain business details and an optional supported local logo, open a real synthetic sample, and review exact setting changes before enabling the chosen operation.
14: * Edition scope - The Light guide supports the Invoice document type, generated manually or on completed orders, with optional attachment to the customer completed-order email.
15: * Merchant control - Sample and attachment rehearsal do not send email, issue production documents or consume invoice numbers. Existing numbering, tax, advanced settings and custom templates are protected; settings undo detects later changes.
16: * Dutch continuity - Adds reviewed Dutch translations across selected core modules and the new setup guide, with English fallback outside the bounded coverage. Merchant-authored content and saved PDF templates are not translated; community and custom language overrides retain priority.
17: * Clear limits - The starter layout needs no HTML editing, but custom layouts remain in advanced settings. Sample success and attachment rehearsal do not confirm production email delivery or tax/legal compliance.
18: * Storefront continuity - Keeps setup redirects out of customer background requests after activation, so saved-list actions can work immediately.
